About Alhaz Sunai Bibi Choudhury College
Alhaz Sunai Bibi Choudhury College (ASBC College) is a well-recognized institution of higher education located in Udali Bazar, Hojai District, Assam. Established in 1997, the college has been serving the educational needs of the region for more than two decades. It plays a significant role in providing access to higher education, especially for students from rural, minority, and economically disadvantaged backgrounds. From the Principal's Desk
Dr. Lakhinanda Bordoloi
, M.A., Ph.D.
Principal, ASBC College
It gives me immense pleasure to welcome all aspirants of knowledge, skill, and innovation to ASBC (Alhaz Sunai Bibi Choudhury) College, one of the fastest-growing institutions of higher education in the Hojai district of Assam. Our college is strategically located with excellent road connectivity from nearby areas such as Lanka, Kaki, Nakhuti, and others. We are situated just 1.5 k. m. from National Highway 36 (Udali Bypass), ensuring easy access for students and visitors alike. ..
